package processor

// Generates the v1.7 detection checkpoints that the v1.8 threshold-carry tests restore
// (backend/services/event-processing/processor/testdata/carry_v17/). It runs only when
// DC_CARRY_FIXTURE_DIR is set, against the release-1.7 tree, so every fixture is written
// by the actual v1.7 engine and processor rather than by a v1.8 imitation of them.
//
//   git worktree add --detach <wt> origin/release-1.7
//   cp <this file> <wt>/backend/services/event-processing/processor/
//   cd <wt>/backend/services/event-processing
//   DC_CARRY_FIXTURE_DIR=<abs>/testdata/carry_v17 go test ./processor -run TestGenerateCarryFixtures -count=1

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"
	"time"

	rules "github.com/devicechain-io/dc-event-processing/internal/rules"
	"github.com/devicechain-io/dc-event-processing/internal/runtime"
	"github.com/devicechain-io/dc-event-processing/model"
	"github.com/devicechain-io/dc-microservice/messaging"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

type carryFixture struct {
	Producer  string          `json:"producer"`
	Scenario  string          `json:"scenario"`
	Shards    int             `json:"shards"`
	StreamSeq int64           `json:"streamSeq"`
	Watermark time.Time       `json:"watermark"`
	Payload   json.RawMessage `json:"payload"`
	Events    []string        `json:"events"`
}

func genRule(t *testing.T, version string) runtime.ScopedRule {
	t.Helper()
	threshold := 80.0
	r := rules.Rule{ID: "acme/p1@" + version + "/r1", Name: "heat", Type: rules.TypeThreshold,
		When: rules.Condition{Metric: "temperature", Op: rules.OpGt, Threshold: &threshold}}
	cr, err := rules.Compile(r, rules.Limits{})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	return runtime.ScopedRule{Tenant: "acme", ProfileVersionToken: "p1@" + version, Compiled: cr}
}

func genProcessor(t *testing.T, k int, store *model.SnapshotStore, active string, scoped ...runtime.ScopedRule) (*ResolvedEventsProcessor, *derivedCapture) {
	t.Helper()
	w := &derivedCapture{}
	rp := newTestProcessor(store, nil, 1000)
	rp.cfg.Shards = k
	rp.registry = runtime.NewRuleRegistry(scoped)
	rp.publisher = runtime.NewPublisher(w, rp.registry, (*DetectMetrics)(nil))
	rp.RosterStore = newProcRosterStore(t)
	rp.ProfileActiveStore = newProcActiveStore(t)
	require.NoError(t, rp.RosterStore.Upsert(context.Background(), &model.DeviceRoster{
		Tenant: "acme", DeviceToken: "dev1", ProfileToken: "p1", ExpectedSince: testBase}))
	require.NoError(t, rp.ProfileActiveStore.Upsert(context.Background(), &model.ProfileActive{
		Tenant: "acme", ProfileToken: "p1", ActiveVersionToken: active, PublishedAt: testBase}))
	require.NoError(t, rp.restore(context.Background()))
	t.Cleanup(rp.closeDetector)
	require.NoError(t, rp.startDeadmanGate(context.Background()))
	return rp, w
}

func genActivate(t *testing.T, rp *ResolvedEventsProcessor, sr runtime.ScopedRule) {
	t.Helper()
	a := runtime.ActiveEntry{Tenant: "acme", ProfileToken: "p1", ActiveVersionToken: sr.ProfileVersionToken, PublishedAt: testBase.Add(10 * time.Second)}
	require.NoError(t, rp.ProfileActiveStore.Upsert(context.Background(), &model.ProfileActive{
		Tenant: a.Tenant, ProfileToken: a.ProfileToken, ActiveVersionToken: a.ActiveVersionToken, PublishedAt: a.PublishedAt}))
	rp.applyRuleUpdate(ruleUpdate{upserts: []runtime.ScopedRule{sr}, active: &a})
}

func genMessage(t *testing.T, seq uint64, version, value string) messaging.Message {
	t.Helper()
	at := testBase.Add(time.Duration(seq) * time.Second)
	m := measuredMsgAt(t, seq, at, "acme", "dev1", "p1@"+version, "temperature", value, &fakeAck{})
	m.AppendTime = at
	return m
}

func genApply(t *testing.T, rp *ResolvedEventsProcessor, m messaging.Message) {
	t.Helper()
	require.True(t, rp.applyResolved(m))
	rp.syncDetector()
}

func genDump(t *testing.T, dir, producer, scenario string, k int, rp *ResolvedEventsProcessor, w *derivedCapture) {
	t.Helper()
	snap, found, err := rp.Store.Load(context.Background(), "singleton")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, found)
	f := carryFixture{Producer: producer, Scenario: scenario, Shards: k, StreamSeq: snap.StreamSeq,
		Watermark: snap.Watermark.UTC(), Payload: json.RawMessage(snap.Payload)}
	for _, e := range w.events {
		f.Events = append(f.Events, fmt.Sprintf("%s %s", e.RuleID, e.Edge))
	}
	b, err := json.MarshalIndent(f, "", "  ")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, fmt.Sprintf("%s-k%d.json", scenario, k)), append(b, '\n'), 0o644))
}

func genLoad(t *testing.T, path string, store *model.SnapshotStore) carryFixture {
	t.Helper()
	b, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	var f carryFixture
	require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(b, &f))
	require.NoError(t, store.Save(context.Background(), &model.DetectSnapshot{
		PartitionId: "singleton", StreamSeq: f.StreamSeq, Watermark: f.Watermark, Payload: []byte(f.Payload)}))
	return f
}

func TestGenerateCarryFixtures(t *testing.T) {
	dir := os.Getenv("DC_CARRY_FIXTURE_DIR")
	if dir == "" {
		t.Skip("DC_CARRY_FIXTURE_DIR not set")
	}
	ctx := context.Background()
	for _, k := range []int{1, 4} {
		// v1 raises and is checkpointed, v2 is published, and v2 then raises and
		// recovers on its own before v1.7 checkpoints again: the v1 latch it leaves is
		// historical, and v2 is clear.
		t.Run(fmt.Sprintf("successor-recovered/%d", k), func(t *testing.T) {
			rp, w := genProcessor(t, k, newTestStore(t), "p1@v1", genRule(t, "v1"))
			genApply(t, rp, genMessage(t, 1, "v1", "90"))
			require.True(t, rp.checkpoint(ctx))
			genActivate(t, rp, genRule(t, "v2"))
			genApply(t, rp, genMessage(t, 2, "v2", "90"))
			genApply(t, rp, genMessage(t, 3, "v2", "20"))
			require.True(t, rp.checkpoint(ctx))
			require.Len(t, w.events, 3)
			genDump(t, dir, "v1.7", "v17-successor-recovered", k, rp, w)
		})
		// v2 only ever reads healthy under v1.7: it emits nothing, and v1.7 never moves
		// the v1 latch, so the checkpoint holds v1 raised and v2 clear.
		t.Run(fmt.Sprintf("successor-healthy/%d", k), func(t *testing.T) {
			rp, w := genProcessor(t, k, newTestStore(t), "p1@v1", genRule(t, "v1"))
			genApply(t, rp, genMessage(t, 1, "v1", "90"))
			require.True(t, rp.checkpoint(ctx))
			genActivate(t, rp, genRule(t, "v2"))
			genApply(t, rp, genMessage(t, 2, "v2", "20"))
			require.True(t, rp.checkpoint(ctx))
			require.Len(t, w.events, 1)
			genDump(t, dir, "v1.7", "v17-successor-healthy", k, rp, w)
		})
		// v1.8 -> v1.7 -> v1.8: v1.7 restores a checkpoint v1.8 wrote before the
		// handoff, takes the v2 publish, sees v2 raise and recover, and checkpoints.
		t.Run(fmt.Sprintf("from-v18/%d", k), func(t *testing.T) {
			store := newTestStore(t)
			in := genLoad(t, filepath.Join(dir, "v18-pre-handoff-k1.json"), store)
			require.Equal(t, "v1.8", in.Producer)
			rp, w := genProcessor(t, k, store, "p1@v2", genRule(t, "v1"), genRule(t, "v2"))
			rp.Replay = &fakeReplayOpener{head: uint64(in.StreamSeq)}
			require.NoError(t, rp.replayToHead())
			require.NoError(t, rp.reconcileDeadmanArming(ctx))
			genApply(t, rp, genMessage(t, 2, "v2", "90"))
			genApply(t, rp, genMessage(t, 3, "v2", "20"))
			require.True(t, rp.checkpoint(ctx))
			require.Len(t, w.events, 2)
			genDump(t, dir, "v1.7", "v17-from-v18", k, rp, w)
		})
	}
}
